instructions.task: Choose exactly one generation mode for the strongest natural, fully supported information need in this already-selected target. Route BEFORE generation; do not grade questions or output draft questions, answers or claims.

input_structure.### TARGET ARTICLE: Supplies the legal point and source-finding clue.
input_structure.### REFERENCED ARTICLES FROM OTHER ACTS: Supplied cited provisions, not independent targets.
input_structure.### REFERENCED ANNEXES: Supplied cited annexes, not independent targets.

instructions.fixed_evidence_and_eligibility:
EUR-LEX BOUNDARY AND ELIGIBILITY
Inputs: ### TARGET ARTICLE; ### REFERENCED ARTICLES; ### REFERENCED ARTICLES FROM OTHER ACTS; ### REFERENCED ANNEXES. Act:, Location:, headings and Cite as: identify units. The target supplies the legal point; explicitly linked supplied provisions may complete it. A reference span is allowed if the target's governing rule remains necessary, not if the reference independently answers the whole question. Different provisions adjacent in a payload are not a contiguous span. In source_finding, substantive evidence for the clue must be in the target body; metadata supplies identity only.
articles_involved contains the target and exactly the units needed for the answer or indispensable legal clarification. Same-act articles: bare numbers. Other-act articles and ALL annexes: exact Cite as keys. Do not declare unused citations or duplicate language versions.
Preserve obligation, permission, prohibition, discretion, actor, conditions and exceptions. A necessary condition is not sufficient; no converse, unstated sanction, invented motive or national implementation. Duties and safeguards do not prove compliance or efficacy.
All modes exclude pure transposition, general commencement/application, addressee/binding-entirety, repeal, generic committee/collection formalities and generic review/audit/delegation/penalty/data-protection boilerplate. A date, comparison, claim wrapper or source-finding clue cannot rescue excluded formal content. A mixed article's substantive content can qualify. Concrete institutional safeguards or accountability mechanisms can qualify for conceptual and the new modes; a heading alone never excludes them. Lookup and fact_pattern additionally retain the existing categorical exclusions of institutional review/report/evaluation, financial-interests/audit access and delegation clauses. These mode-specific restrictions do not exclude a substantive institutional target from every mode.
decision_process: Locate the target’s substantive evidence before considering labels. Check actual speaking capacity, modality, necessary conditions and source/event time. Apply the content policy to the proposed need, not the document heading. The existing preprocessing filters remain unchanged.

Consider the strongest feasible information need for EACH mode, using the evidence witness below. A source contains facts; it does not contain a pre-existing user query. A natural case, uncertain assertion or source clue may be formed from it during generation. Do not require those wrappers to appear verbatim in the target.

Distinguish DIRECT FIT from MERELY POSSIBLE: the former uses an explicit comparison, task-trigger, rationale, decisive claim distinction, source clue or precise point naturally; the latter adds decoration or mechanically converts any sentence to a question. Choose the best direct evidence-to-intent fit, not the shortest answer or easiest extraction.

Do not automatically prefer lookup just because the text is factual, a citation exists, or lookup could express the same content. Equally, do not prefer a new mode just to diversify output. A meaningful comparison or case must not lose its defining intent when assessed as a generic factual paraphrase.

When several modes are genuinely strong, prefer the more coherent bounded need with fewer invented assumptions, clearer substantive identification and sufficient actual evidence. Either may be defensible in a real tie: do not skip, invent scores or impose a fixed mode hierarchy. No frequency target or rarity bonus.

Use reliable source, event or session anchors actually supplied. A letter date does not date the target act; a directory year does not establish adoption; a session number is not a calendar year. Missing indispensable time can exclude a need; supported session/event context may suffice without an invented year.

Check the unknown: an uncertain assertion may state the proposition without revealing its verdict; a remembered source-finding clue may state the proposition without revealing its identity; a case may state a relevant omission without stating the required consequence. Do not confuse these with actual answer leakage.

Require one sufficient contiguous evidence span. A fragment can decide the point, material qualifications and minimal intervening text stay, and no rewritten synthesis is required. For source_finding, identity is the permitted metadata answer and a separate target-body span proves its clue.

One high-quality candidate is enough. Skip only if all six modes lack a qualifying need. Do not estimate verifier scores, maximize expected candidate count, impose desired mode shares or use the examples as exclusive full-document gold labels.

lookup.known: A regime or, for UN, a particular source.
lookup.unknown: One precise legal point, fact, condition, requested action or bounded procedure.
lookup.evidence_witness: One useful point explicitly resolved by the permitted evidence; naturally asked directly.
lookup.not_enough: An available identifier, an easy answer span or the fact that every other intent can be rewritten as a fact question. Those do not make lookup the best route.

fact_pattern.known: A private party or national file-handling authority has concrete circumstances, but not the instrument.
fact_pattern.unknown: How the explicit rule treats that case, or what the actor must do for that task.
fact_pattern.evidence_witness: At least two meaningful scope/condition particulars can instantiate the source rule, and the actual ask uses them. Ordinary application qualifies.
fact_pattern.not_enough: A decorative role, an arbitrary quantity followed by a general threshold question, or one met condition used to assume complete entitlement. EU institutional protagonists and the retained excluded topics do not qualify for this mode.

conceptual.known: An issue or situation, not the governing source or its exact wording.
conceptual.unknown: One expressly established rationale, problem/response relationship, connected safeguard set or stakeholder role.
conceptual.evidence_witness: The target connects substantive facts that explain that relationship. Institutional and non-binding relationships can be fully useful.
conceptual.not_enough: An isolated number or definition wrapped in how/why; an objective offered as proof of effectiveness; a hypothetical case; or two-sided comparison whose defining need is the contrast.

comparison.known: Two meaningful sides and a common subject.
comparison.unknown: Their treatment, similarity, difference or relationship on ONE substantive aspect.
comparison.evidence_witness: Both sides are explicitly established in one sufficient permitted contiguous span. Baseline/additional protection and explicit identical treatment qualify.
comparison.not_enough: Two names, a group and a member merely repeated in one appeal, two unrelated topics, addresses, ceremonial thanks or one absent position. The text need not use contrast words. Do not require disjoint categories or different treatment.

claim_verification.known: A plausible substantive assertion presented as uncertain.
claim_verification.unknown: Whether the permitted source evidence supports or contradicts that assertion at the same scope/time/attribution.
claim_verification.evidence_witness: A clear status, scope, actor, condition, timing or other material point can be checked decisively. Correct and incorrect assertions are both possible.
claim_verification.not_enough: The mere ability to negate any sentence, an entire paragraph inside a checking wrapper, silence, partial evidence or invented history. This routes question generation, not a grader.

source_finding.known: A remembered substantive proposition, with enough programme/mission/topic/time context.
source_finding.unknown: The identity of the target provision or document containing it.
source_finding.evidence_witness: A concise meaningful target-body clue plus unambiguous supplied target identity. The source is useful to find from that clue, without revealing its identifier.
source_finding.not_enough: A title or number to copy, a generic date formula, an exhaustive list of neighboring facts or a reference-only proposition. Do not require or assert corpus-wide uniqueness.

teaching_examples.teaching_scope: Choice applies to the excerpt and context shown; omitted clauses are not evidence. This is a preferred teaching route, not proof that no other mode could work.
teaching_examples.target_excerpt:
Subject matter and scope

1. This Regulation establishes requirements for the energy labelling of, and the provision of supplementary product information on, space heaters and combination heaters with a rated heat output ≤ 70 kW, packages of space heater ≤ 70 kW, temperature control and solar device and packages of combination heater ≤ 70 kW, temperature control and solar device.
teaching_examples.context_used_only_for_identification: EU energy labelling of space and combination heaters.
teaching_examples.why_this_intent_fits: A direct question about the explicit rated-heat-output scope is natural. A precise scope rule is useful without a client story.
teaching_examples.do_not_confuse_with: A 60 kW detail followed by a request for the general threshold is not an application need. An eligibility case must actually use its facts.

instructions.language: Decide by meaning in all supplied languages. Translations are the same evidence, not independent corroboration. Language variants do not alter these intent boundaries.

criteria.lookup: Choose when a direct, precise point is the strongest natural need: the user knows the regime/source and lacks that point. The base and cited rendering must both work. Do not prefer this merely because all content can be expressed as a fact or the identifier is available.
criteria.fact_pattern: Choose when source-relevant circumstances of a private party or national file-handling authority create a genuine application need, with at least two meaningful particulars and all conditions needed for the actual ask. A routine case qualifies; a decorated generic lookup does not.
criteria.conceptual: Choose when the target most naturally explains one substantive rationale, response, safeguard relationship or affected party’s role. Situation, response and stakeholder are equal. Neither a legal consequence nor effectiveness is required; isolated data and invented why claims do not qualify.
criteria.comparison: Choose when two meaningful sides on a common aspect are explicitly evidenced together and that two-sided relationship is the natural missing information. Equal treatment and category/subcategory distinctions can qualify. Mere adjacency, two names or an absent second side cannot.
criteria.claim_verification: Choose when a plausible uncertainty about a material assertion is naturally and decisively checked by this evidence. Supported and explicitly contradicted are equally valid. Do not invent a claimant, force false assertions, treat silence as contradiction or wrap an entire paragraph mechanically.
criteria.source_finding: Choose when a meaningful substantive proposition provides a natural clue for locating this target and exact supplied metadata supplies its identity. The clue must come from the target body, not just metadata or a cited source. Do not reveal the identity, fingerprint a whole passage or rescue formal boilerplate.
criteria.skip: Choose only when no one of the six modes has a substantive, grounded, informative need under its own rules. A pure formal/ceremonial excerpt can warrant skip. One mode failing, an institutional heading, non-binding content or several valid modes do not justify skipping.
